failures.query: Can I return an item that was 25% off?

detail.generation: all needed sources present; reply still flagged

issues: unsupported fact: Only items discounted 30% or more at the time of purchase are final sale.
failures.answer:
Yes, in general. An item bought at 25% off is below the 30% final-sale threshold, so the discount alone doesn't make it non-returnable. Only items discounted 30% or more at the time of purchase are final sale.

It can still be returned if it meets the standard requirements:
- The return is started within 30 days of the original purchase date.
- The item is unworn, unwashed and unaltered, with the original tags attached, and in sellable condition.
- You have your order number or proof of purchase.

Some things would still make it ineligible, whatever the discount:
- The item was marked "Final Sale" at checkout. If so, the return is declined regardless of the reason.
- The item is a bodysuit (including bodysuits with built-in shorts), underwear or intimates, a supplement or wellness consumable, a café or food item, or a gift card.
- The item came from a third-party seller.
- A promo code brought the total discount to 30% or more.

For online U.S. orders, start the return at returns.aloyoga.com with your order number and checkout email. You'll get a prepaid UPS label, which expires 21 days after it's generated. I can't see a specific order here, so check that your item doesn't fall into one of the exclusions above.
